Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "so i'm setting up the offline reading app on the small tablet in the cabin where the connection drops out most evenings and i want the setup to be something my sister can repeat when she borrows it i call the app AsterBrief and the tablet is a 10 inch model with 64 gigabytes of storage the app already opens and the library screen is readable but the local copies are not staying available after a restart please make the changes in the order i describe and leave the account signed in because the travel list is attached to it i am asking for a configuration plan not a change to the account or a guess about why the old copies disappeared

first set the download location to the folder called cabin shelf which is already on the tablet do not make another folder with a similar name inside it there are 18 gigabytes free right now and that number is the available space before any new books are downloaded i want to keep at least 4 gigabytes free for maps and system updates so use 14 gigabytes as the maximum reading library size not as a target to fill the entire device the app should show the size of the local library separately from the tablet's overall storage so i can tell which number i'm looking at the menu label currently says storage used and that is a little confusing

for the local setting please enable the preference that keeps downloaded books on this device even when the account list refreshes set the value to true and do not rename the key the key is on its own line here
reader.prefer_local
that is the literal configuration key i need you to use in the instruction for the setting i don't know whether the menu will display the same words or a friendlier label so mention both the key and the visible setting name if there is one do not assume the setting also prevents the app from checking for updates because i still want the check to happen whenever the tablet is online

set the automatic download limit to 8 books at a time i was going to say six no eight books at a time because some of the longer titles have maps and take longer to finish keep that number as a limit on simultaneous downloads not a limit on the number of books in the library the travel list currently has 23 titles and i want the app to keep all 23 listed even when only some of them have local copies also leave the reading position and highlights available on the account so those can follow me to my phone later but the book files themselves should be available offline on this tablet

numbered section, one, choose the cabin shelf folder as the download location and confirm it is the existing folder, two, turn on the local preference using the exact key above and set it to true, three, set the simultaneous download limit to eight books, four, keep the full travel list visible and show which titles have local copies, five, display local library size and available tablet storage as separate figures these are separate steps, not five alternative ways of doing the same thing if a step depends on a menu option that is not present tell me which option is missing instead of silently substituting a different setting

there is one timing detail that matters when the tablet is back at the apartment it usually connects to wifi around 7 in the evening and my sister sometimes opens the app before then if a title is already downloaded she should be able to open it without waiting for a connection if it is only on the account list she should see that it still needs a download and not an error that sounds like the book was deleted if the tablet is online at 7 let the app check for updates then but do not make an update check a condition for opening an existing local copy

please include a short note about what happens when there is not enough free space for a requested download the 4 gigabyte reserve is important and i do not want the app to use that reserve without telling us if the app can stop before reaching that reserve say so if it cannot enforce that boundary say that too i haven't checked whether the storage control can prevent a download or only show a warning so don't say it definitely blocks the download a clear distinction between a warning and a hard limit would help me explain the setup to my sister

for testing use two sample titles from the travel list one short story of about 12 megabytes and one illustrated guide of about 680 megabytes those are approximate file sizes from the publisher page not exact sizes measured on this tablet download them while online then switch off wifi and restart the app check that both titles open and that the reading position remains where it was also check that the local library figure increases by the amount actually stored rather than the approximate publisher sizes there may be a small difference because of cover images or other files and please don't treat that difference as a failed test by itself

lastly keep the directions usable for someone who doesn't know the settings menu yet use the menu labels as they appear on screen and put the exact configuration key beside the local preference so i can find it if the label is different if you cannot tell whether a control is available on this version say that it needs checking before we rely on it i don't know the app version number and i haven't tried these settings since the last tablet update please keep that uncertainty in the instructions and end with the check that the two downloaded titles still open after wifi is off and the app has restarted", "output": "So I'm setting up the offline reading app on the small tablet in the cabin, where the connection drops out most evenings, and I want the setup to be something my sister can repeat when she borrows it. I call the app AsterBrief, and the tablet is a 10-inch model with 64 gigabytes of storage. The app already opens, and the library screen is readable, but the local copies aren't staying available after a restart. Please make the changes in the order I describe and leave the account signed in, because the travel list is attached to it. I'm asking for a configuration plan, not a change to the account or a guess about why the old copies disappeared.

First, set the download location to the folder called Cabin Shelf, which is already on the tablet. Don't make another folder with a similar name inside it. There are 18 gigabytes free right now, and that number is the available space before any new books are downloaded. I want to keep at least 4 gigabytes free for maps and system updates, so use 14 gigabytes as the maximum reading library size, not as a target to fill the entire device. The app should show the size of the local library separately from the tablet's overall storage, so I can tell which number I'm looking at. The menu label currently says “Storage used,” and that's a little confusing.

For the local setting, please enable the preference that keeps downloaded books on this device even when the account list refreshes. Set the value to true, and don't rename the key. The key is on its own line here:
reader.prefer_local
That is the literal configuration key I need you to use in the instruction for the setting. I don't know whether the menu will display the same words or a friendlier label, so mention both the key and the visible setting name if there is one. Don't assume the setting also prevents the app from checking for updates, because I still want the check to happen whenever the tablet is online.

Set the automatic download limit to 8 books at a time. I was going to say six—no, eight books at a time—because some of the longer titles have maps and take longer to finish. Keep that number as a limit on simultaneous downloads, not a limit on the number of books in the library. The travel list currently has 23 titles, and I want the app to keep all 23 listed even when only some of them have local copies. Also leave the reading position and highlights available on the account so those can follow me to my phone later, but the book files themselves should be available offline on this tablet.

Numbered section:
1. Choose the Cabin Shelf folder as the download location and confirm it's the existing folder.
2. Turn on the local preference using the exact key above and set it to true.
3. Set the simultaneous download limit to eight books.
4. Keep the full travel list visible and show which titles have local copies.
5. Display local library size and available tablet storage as separate figures.
These are separate steps, not five alternative ways of doing the same thing. If a step depends on a menu option that isn't present, tell me which option is missing instead of silently substituting a different setting.

There's one timing detail that matters. When the tablet is back at the apartment, it usually connects to Wi-Fi around 7 in the evening, and my sister sometimes opens the app before then. If a title is already downloaded, she should be able to open it without waiting for a connection. If it's only on the account list, she should see that it still needs a download, not an error that sounds like the book was deleted. If the tablet is online at 7, let the app check for updates then, but don't make an update check a condition for opening an existing local copy.

Please include a short note about what happens when there isn't enough free space for a requested download. The 4-gigabyte reserve is important, and I don't want the app to use that reserve without telling us. If the app can stop before reaching that reserve, say so. If it can't enforce that boundary, say that too. I haven't checked whether the storage control can prevent a download or only show a warning, so don't say it definitely blocks the download. A clear distinction between a warning and a hard limit would help me explain the setup to my sister.

For testing, use two sample titles from the travel list: one short story of about 12 megabytes and one illustrated guide of about 680 megabytes. Those are approximate file sizes from the publisher page, not exact sizes measured on this tablet. Download them while online, then switch off Wi-Fi and restart the app. Check that both titles open and that the reading position remains where it was. Also check that the local library figure increases by the amount actually stored rather than the approximate publisher sizes. There may be a small difference because of cover images or other files, and please don't treat that difference as a failed test by itself.

Lastly, keep the directions usable for someone who doesn't know the settings menu yet. Use the menu labels as they appear on screen, and put the exact configuration key beside the local preference so I can find it if the label is different. If you can't tell whether a control is available on this version, say that it needs checking before we rely on it. I don't know the app version number, and I haven't tried these settings since the last tablet update. Please keep that uncertainty in the instructions, and end with the check that the two downloaded titles still open after Wi-Fi is off and the app has restarted."}]
